query: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(dim_date[fiscal_year], dim_room[room_name], dim_room[capacity], TREATAS({"Hall"}, dim_room[room_type]), "Utilization", [Hall Utilization %], "HoursBooked", [Hours Booked], "HoursAvailable", [Hours Available], "BookedDays", [Booked Days], "EventsBooked", [Events Booked], "Cancelled", [Cancelled Events], "RentalFees", [Rental Fees]) ORDER BY dim_date[fiscal_year], dim_room[room_name]
